dialog.description: Version and notes of the next release.

deploy.started: Started – the process is running on the server.

runtime.confirmText: Fetches origin/main via git reset --hard (local changes on the server are lost), makes a database backup, rebuilds and restarts the server. The site is unavailable meanwhile.

frontend.confirmText: Fetches origin/main via git reset --hard, builds the frontend on the server and swaps it live. The current version keeps running until then. Open tabs get the update notice afterwards.

admin.confirmText: Fetches origin/main via git reset --hard, builds the admin app on the server and swaps it live. The current version keeps running until then.
